mechanism: NVIDIA's 800 VDC AI-factory architecture can accelerate SiC and GaN adoption and can reduce current, copper, conversion stages and power-delivery constraints around NVIDIA systems, but NVIDIA is the architecture and compute vendor rather than the evidenced WBG component supplier and discloses no material WBG-attributable revenue or margin.
